title: Hold four houses instead of hotel
description: Hold four houses instead of hotel. Upgrading to hotel releases houses and weakens Alpha's house-shortage leverage. The decision depends on house supply, immediate rent threat, and whether the reserve survives the build.

final_action.private_thought: I have $520 cash and three orange properties each with 4 houses. Building hotels on all three costs $300 total, leaving $220 cash. This maximizes rent potential and uses up houses efficiently. No need to mortgage now.
